query: how to refund involuntary reissued ticket
answer:
Amadeus involuntary reissued ticket
In this example there is no amount after total, instead it says NO ADC which means no additional collect. We now know that there s been no fare difference for this new ticket which indicates an involuntary reissue. It is visible in the bottom of the ticket calculation on the TOTAL amount row.
But to be absolutely sure we need to check the remarks and look for an EMD in the PNR. To check, use either RTF or RHFA to locate any possible additional EMD and ticket numbers.

When a ticket is reissued due to involuntary reasons we always try to find seats available in the same class, but if that is not possible the airline might give an authorization to upgrade the ticket.

query: steps to follow for a cancellation refund through lcc if the customer has cancelled the ticket directly with the airline
answer:
Cancellation requests received after 24 hours
Customer claims that cancelled directly with the airline within 24H and contacts ETG at a later date(after 24H of date of purchase)
If the customer has cancelled the ticket directly with the airline and contacts us for refund, follow the below steps:
GDS/PORTALS
1) Check PNR history to verify when segments were removed from the PNR.
2) If segments have been removed within 24H after the purchase, use the cancellation reason BR to queue the order to SL.Always send cancellation confirmation email.
2.1) If the segments have not been removed within 24H after the purchase, inform the customer that the ticket is not eligible for full refund
3) Write in the notes that the customer has already cancelled the ticket with the airline.
LCC
1) Check the booking on the airline's website to verify the status.
2) Check OTRs to verify if the customer has cancelled within 24H or
3) check VAN if funds have been received from the airline within 24H
4) If no concrete confirmation has been retrieved, advise the customer to provide a written proof from the airline that cancellation was performed within the 24 H time frame.Inform customer that a written proof of cancellation within 24H is necessary in order for us to proceed.
5) Send email from Edvin titled LCC confirmation request from pax for 24H BR In this email template the customer can use a link with a dedicated contact form to attach the proof that he/she cancelled the booking directly with the carrier.
7) All contact forms when filled by customers will be delivered to Etrack inbox BR (to be handled by BR support team)
8) If the proof is valid, FL will proceed with further actions by running and using BR If the proof is not valid, contact the customer and inform them that the booking is not eligible for full refund.

query: steps for rebooking

Rebooking
How to rebook step-by -step:

**If your PNR is round-trip, remember that the same actions need to take place for a second time.

query: how to refund involuntary reissued ticket
answer:

Refund of involuntary reissued ticket
When a ticket is reissued due to involuntary reasons we always try to find seats available in the same class, but if that is not possible the airline might give us the authorization to upgrade the ticket. This could mean that the refund rules differ between the original ticket and the reissued one.
However, since it is not by the choice of the passenger to change the ticket we will always go by the rules of the original ticket in this scenario.

answer:

56WI E-TRAVEL SA/DE

answer:

We will inform you that BO makes the calculation as some taxes may not be refunded in this case. Only if he is entitled to a refund after deducting our fee we will Modify order.

query: how to handle tech alerts in schedule change
answer:
Tech Alerts
As many of you may know, when an airline changes something in the PNR, we get a notification in our system. For example, schedule change notification (UN/TK) or when the airline exchanges a ticket. However, we do have cases where there is a technical error in the airline's system, and they have to notify us of a change they have had while the aircraft were still in operation. For such cases, the airline provides us with a special policy for a specific route and date that we must follow.
In the need to inform all parties involved of such errors a new category (Attribute) has been created in the Edvin Documents/Schedule Change tab, that will include the proper airline policy to follow.
Until now, the schedule change agent had to check the flight status in GDS to identify the schedule change and inform the passenger about the possible alternatives, based on the Edvin Documents for SC Policies.
Now having in mind the possibility of a technical error, we should follow the below:
1. Open order in Edvin.
2. Open PNR in GDS and check flight status and flight number.
3. Open the Edvin Docs, first checking whether there is a new technical error under the attribute that affects that specific flight in the PNR for the specific period mentioned.
3.1. If this is indeed a please follow the instructions of that category and not the normal SC policy.
3.2. If the flight details do not match with the information, please proceed with any alternatives that can be provided as per the Schedule Change policy or Covid-19.
The information will be shared:
1. With the SC team through an email.
2. Through Edvin Documents in SC tab.
3. Through Shelf- SC folder- Tech Alerts.
ATTENTION: In case the instructions are not followed, ADMs will be issued from the airline(s)
Docs Ref: Schedule change notifications as Tech Alerts

query: steps for rebooking with manual change
answer:
Step by Step - Amadeus Manual Change
You use manual calculation only when ATC not applicable by airline and changes are permitted in fare rules in the same pnr.
Possible error message you may receive when you try ATC: Check category 31(amadeus)
Always check Fare rules (Category 16) and Max/Min. stay (Category 06 & 07) quoting rebooking charges for
manual rebooking.
The most important fare rules are:
16.PENALTIES
11.BLACKOUTS
03.SEASONS
04.FLIGHT APPL
05.ADV RES/TKTG
06.MIN STAY
07.MAX STAY
Availability
1. Retrieve pnr in respective office id, use RT+pnr
2. Make availability for new flights using below command: sn(date)(citypair)/a(al) ex: sn25decatharn/ask
3. Select seats: ss(n.of seats)(class)(line of flight) ex. SS1Y1 OR SS1YY1( If flight with connection)
4. Then RT to retrieve pnr
ATTENTION:
There are airlines, like EK where before the availability and the seat selection must be made after the original segments are removed (removed without saving). Please follow the steps below:
1. Retrieve the existing PNR
2. Remove the original dates (DO NOT SAVE any segments). Do a fresh availability and sell for the new itinerary required by the passenger. The agent may not see accurate availability, unless holding segments are cancelled.
3. After removing the segments, if there is no availability for new dates, the agent can ignore and retrieve the existing PNR No seats from the original booking would have been lost.
Pricing
1. Price all segments that he will use. If you have round trip and he asks to rebook OB and keep IB you have to include in the command new OB and old IB.
2. Pricing: Fxx/s1,2/r,up (informative- prices the class you have selected)
Or: Fxp/s1,2 ( prices the classes you have selected and saves the mask)
3. Pricing: Fxb/s1,2,4/r,up ( prices the best available combination, check that no downgrade has been done)
4. To open specific fare basis pricing mask use FQQ(line of fare basis you want)
Calculation
1. No flexible tkt: Compare fare+taxes one by one with old ticket in GDS.+penalty from fare rules and convert to pax currency
2. Create Add on cart: total yy cost+our voluntary rebooking service fee

query: how to handle tech alerts in schedule change
answer:
Tech Alerts
As many of you may know, when an airline changes something in the PNR, we get a notification in our system. For example, schedule change notification (UN/TK) or when the airline exchanges a ticket. However, we do have cases where there is a technical error in the airline's system, and they have to notify us of a change they have had while the aircraft were still in operation. For such cases, the airline provides us with a special policy for a specific route and date that we must follow.
In the need to inform all parties involved of such errors a new category (Attribute) has been created in the Edvin Documents/Schedule Change tab, that will include the proper airline policy to follow.
Until now, the schedule change agent had to check the flight status in GDS to identify the schedule change and inform the passenger about the possible alternatives, based on the Edvin Documents for SC Policies.
Now having in mind the possibility of a technical error, we should follow the below:
1. Open order in Edvin.
2. Open PNR in GDS and check flight status and flight number.
3. Open the Edvin Docs, first checking whether there is a new technical error under the attribute that affects that specific flight in the PNR for the specific period mentioned.
3.1. If this is indeed a please follow the instructions of that category and not the normal SC policy.
3.2. If the flight details do not match with the information, please proceed with any alternatives that can be provided as per the Schedule Change policy or Covid-19.
The information will be shared:
1. With the SC team through an email.
2. Through Edvin Documents in SC tab.
3. Through Shelf- SC folder- Tech Alerts.
ATTENTION: In case the instructions are not followed, ADMs will be issued from the airline(s)
Docs Ref: Schedule change notifications as Tech Alerts

query: steps for void cancellation
answer:
Step by Step - Void a Ticket - Sabre
Checklist:
1) Have I checked in Edvin for any void restrictions? If nothing is mentioned in the docs, have I checked the fare rules and the HEETT(YY) command?
2) Have I checked if the VOID automation applies as described here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/09665f68-4407-41b5-a687-4078dc2f7e7a >>?
3) Have I remembered to void all the tickets including infants and EMDs?
4) Is it a Single or Multiple PNR?
5) Any LCC involved?
6) Is it a CC2C order?
7) Remember to void before you cancel the segments. It is much more time-consuming to do it afterwards...
8) Voiding a ticket is only possible if the ticket was issued the same day (voiding is possible until midnight and if no discrepancies apply according to airline info in Edvin and/or fare rules)
ATTENTION: In case you are processing void and the tickets are not issued yet, please make sure that before and after modifying the order you will do IR to make sure that there are no tickets issued in the meantime.
Unless the order in Edvin is marked with the banner 'Delayed Ticketing', the tickets in the GDS are issued automatically, usually within 10 minutes from the time of the order creation/ payment.
Follow below guidelines for void in Amadeus/ Sabre.
1) Check if the void is still possible technically (time conversion)
To be sure of the issuing date and place of issue, open the tickets in GDS. Due to the fact that we have many different office IDs, we need to check the time in the issuing area.
For example, this ticket was booked on 10 January 20 in the SYD office.
Customer called us a few hours later and asked for cancellation (VOID).
Ticket is issued in our area: SYD
We need to check what time and day it is now that we wish to void the ticket in SYD so as to make sure we are still in the same calendar day for the area the ticket was issued in.
Use command in amadeus DDXXX (where XXX is the POI area of our ticket).
E.g DDSYD
2) Check if the airline has any restrictions in Edvin docs and/or GDS with the following commands
After you have made sure that for the ticket issuance area we are still on the same calendar day, we need to check if there are any restrictions by the airline for permitting void.
Void is not guaranteed for all airlines, tickets and/or fare types.
First check Edvin CXL docs for the airline that the ticket stock belongs to so as to make sure if there are any restrictions in place for your ticket.
If there is nothing mentioned in Edvin docs, do not assume that the void option is eligible.
You need to follow the next 2 steps to make sure we can void the ticket without receiving later on either an error or a charge by the airline.
2.1) Open fare rules and read the section for any void restriction.
2.2) Do the HEETT + YY code command in Amadeus to check if VOID is permitted by the airline in the respective office, even if the ticket is issued in Sabre.
E.g let's say we need to check void for KM airline in AU (SYD) office.
We do HEETT + YY code and search for the country code corresponding to the ticket issuance office.
If you handle a Sabre booking and you are not sure which country code corresponds to the ticket issuance office, you may use in Sabre the command W/* + PCC office code.
Once you find the relevant market, type the respective command visible on the right side in order to check the restrictions for the office you need:
Our next command is MS22 and we move down until we find stands for void is technically possible.
3) If void is possible and passenger wishes to proceed after informing them our handling fee, continue with the void commands.
Note:
You must be in the correct area where the ticket has been issued, to be able to void it, or else system will respond with error message
ETKT DOCUMENTS NOT FOUND or VOID ENTRY MUST BE MADE BY PSEUDO CITY OF ORIGINAL.
EMD's must be voided as well if voiding the air tickets.
If partial cancellation is applied, always split the passengers who want to cancel, guidelines can be found here.
If you have cancelled the segments before void entry:
You can void after, if you use: TRDC/TK-TKTNR.
Always remove the first 3 numbers in the ticket number.
EX: TRDC/TK-144XXXXXX
Don't forget to void all the tickets if all tickets are affected.
Please see cancellation fee in Edvin.
How to Void Ticket and EMD
Open the PNR in the GDS and check whether the tickets and EMD are issued.
Amadeus RTTN
Sabre *T
In Amadeus, the ticket line number will be denoted by 'ET', circled in purple above and the EMD will be denoted by 'DT', circled in red. In this example, LH is the issuing carrier/plating carrier for the ticket and EMD.
4) Delete the segments
5) Add ghostline
6) Run Modify Order with reason Send Void confirmation email from Edvin
Sabre:
Open pnr in respective office id. Use *PNR
Check the Ticket status (O or A) in the ticket line. Use *T to open the ticket line. WETR*2 to open ticket.
Check the issuance date and time in the respective city.
Check documents for void exceptions. If nothing is mentioned in Edvin docs, check the fare rules and do the HEETT(YY) command as described above. If no restrictions are found, move on to the next step.
Void tickets: WV2 (no. of ticket line) and again the same command WV2
Check ticket status is VOID
Press *T to open ticket records
Open the ticket you have voided with the command WETR*X where X is the number of the line of the ticket or WETR*TXXXXXXXXXXXXX (ticket number without "-") where XXXXXXXXXXXXX is the number of the ticket
Check the status of the ticket: if it is VOID, means the ticket was successfully voided
Delete segments: X1-5 or X1/3 and then initials + ER to save and IR to double check
Proceed with Modify Order key in Edvin and select : Void (Note: "Modify Order" creates automatically a register errand! Write the free-flow text as an order note in the "note" box and insert all fees in detail.
Send cancellation confirmation email from Edvin for Void.

query: how to void
answer:
1) Jump to correct PCC on same window: AAApcc name
2) Open PNR: *PNR
Example:
AAA4ZTH
*ABCDEF
3) Open ticket list for all passengers: *T

Example: W/*56WI
56WI E-TRAVEL SA/DE
BERLIN, DE

1) Void each ticket with command WVline of the ticket
Example: WV2 (where 2 is the line of the ticket)
The action must be done twice to confirm it, so please reenter the command you previously used.
2) To cancel segments, use the command X segment lines.
Example: X1-4
Every action should be saved in the end with 6 your signature (initials), and ER.

query: steps for rebooking with manual change
answer:
Step by Step - Amadeus Manual Change
You use manual calculation only when ATC not applicable by airline and changes are permitted in fare rules in the same pnr.
Possible error message you may receive when you try ATC: Check category 31(amadeus)
Always check Fare rules (Category 16) and Max/Min. stay (Category 06 & 07) quoting rebooking charges for

The most important fare rules are:
16.PENALTIES
11.BLACKOUTS
03.SEASONS
04.FLIGHT APPL
05.ADV RES/TKTG
06.MIN STAY
07.MAX STAY
Availability
1. Retrieve pnr in respective office id, use RT+pnr
2. Make availability for new flights using below command: sn(date)(citypair)/a(al) ex: sn25decatharn/ask
3. Select seats: ss(n.of seats)(class)(line of flight) ex. SS1Y1 OR SS1YY1( If flight with connection)
4. Then RT to retrieve pnr
ATTENTION:
There are airlines, like EK where before the availability and the seat selection must be made after the original segments are removed (removed without saving). Please follow the steps below:
1. Retrieve the existing PNR
2. Remove the original dates (DO NOT SAVE any segments). Do a fresh availability and sell for the new itinerary required by the passenger. The agent may not see accurate availability, unless holding segments are cancelled.
3. After removing the segments, if there is no availability for new dates, the agent can ignore and retrieve the existing PNR No seats from the original booking would have been lost.
Pricing
1. Price all segments that he will use. If you have round trip and he asks to rebook OB and keep IB you have to include in the command new OB and old IB.
2. Pricing: Fxx/s1,2/r,up (informative- prices the class you have selected)
Or: Fxp/s1,2 ( prices the classes you have selected and saves the mask)
3. Pricing: Fxb/s1,2,4/r,up ( prices the best available combination, check that no downgrade has been done)
4. To open specific fare basis pricing mask use FQQ(line of fare basis you want)

1. No flexible tkt: Compare fare+taxes one by one with old ticket in GDS.+penalty from fare rules and convert to pax currency
2. Create Add on cart: total yy cost+our voluntary rebooking service fee
3. If flexible applied: Compare fare+taxes one by one with old ticket in GDS.
4. If you have IT fare: Use TQT to check fare amount of original ticket.
5. Create Add on cart: Sum up fare and tax from comparison. No penalty applies
6. If passenger will not proceed or you've created Add on cart and it is not working, ignore the pnr and register errand in rebooking wizard with no queue action

1. Once payment link is paid we do all above steps again
2. query: how to check fare rules and cancel
answer:
Step by Step - Check fare rules and Cancel - Amadeus
Sabre
1) Open PNR in respective office id, use *PNR
2) Check Ticket status (O or A) in the ticket line. Use *T to open the ticket line. WETR*2 to open ticket
3) Check the penalties for all fare basis on the ticket. For detailed steps please refer here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/f10842cc-55dd-4ba2-842e-03abea752b0d >>.
4) If nothing is mentioned in fare rules and documents, take the most restrictive penalty within the entity (pricing unit or fare component). More information can be found here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/c5520e56-7b43-443e-87b2-7c12e5c6c98e >>.
5) Inform the passenger about the airline penalty converted in pax currency using the Order creation date along with our Refund fee. All fees are per person.
6) Inform the passenger about the airline penalty converted in his currency using the ticket issuance date along with our Refund fee. All fees are per person.
7) If he confirms: Modify the order in Edvin, selecting the correct reason (Ticket rules-airline fee)
8) No need to register an errand again. Modify order already includes that
9) Send respective confirmation email from Edvin.
10) If the ticket's rule is non-refundable, then we just inform the passenger that the ticket is non-refundable. Nothing else. Only if the passenger asks for taxes then we could check after deducting our tax refund fee if something will remain. In this case, we will inform the passenger about our fee without giving any calculation or exact refund amount. We will inform you that BO makes the calculation as some taxes may not be refunded in this case. Only if he is entitled to a refund after deducting our fee we will Modify order.
General: If a ticket was exchanged, usually you need to check the original ticket and insert the original ticket issue date in your command.
If the ticket is partially used you usually need to check the ''After departure'' section of the rules, unless otherwise specified.
Status : A
Indicates : Airport control
Status : C
Indicates : Checked-in
Status : E
Indicates : Exchanged
Status : F
Indicates : Flown/used
Status : G
Indicates : Passenger must be rerouted due to flight interruption
Status : I
Indicates : Irregular operations
Status : L
Indicates : Lifted/boarded
Status : O
Indicates : Open for use
Status : P
Indicates : Printed
Status : R
Indicates : Refunded
Status : S
Indicates : Suspended
Status : U
Indicates : Unavailable
Status : V
Indicates : Voided
Status : X
Indicates : Print Exchanged
Status : Y
Indicates : Refund tax only
Status : Z
Indicates : Closed
Docs Ref: Step by Step - Check fare rules and Cancel - Amadeus and Sabre

query: how to handle name correction (naco) requests when booking under the void window
answer:
In case the customer contacts us for NACO/NACH about INF (infant) passenger while void is still possible. We will propose to issue a new ticket for Infant and Adult tickets who are associated with Infant, while we are voiding the old tickets with the wrong name
Step by step for void & new ticket:
1. Check if a void is possible and if it is in a void window. If the booking is out of the Void window or not possible to void, follow the NACO general process mentioned in Shelf and Edvin Docs.
2. If Void is possible; Check the availability for the same flights before advising the Void option.
3. Inform the customer of the applicable fare difference for both passenger Infant and Adult tickets who are associated with Infant (Our fees for both Adult and infant will not be charged). The new ticket fare difference should be calculated with the original ticket fare and taxes. Collect the payment via Moto during the call or via the Payment link. Also, collect the passport copy or identity card copy from the passenger via etrack.
4. Once we receive the payment from the customer, Split the Adult on whom the Infant is associated if needed (If there is more than one Adult) and link the PNR in Edvin.
5. Void the original ticket of the Infant and associated Adult and cancel the segments in the original PNR.
In this case, we do not refund to the customer (Do not run the modify Order).
6. Create a new PNR for both passengers (Infant and Adult) with the correct name, also add passenger docs information, and link the PNR in Edvin.
7. Send the new PNR to the ticketing using the'' Ticketing template'' from register errands for a new ticket name change. Select template TKT info name change (Amadeus/Sabre/Galileo).
8. Put on queue in Edvin in order to send the booking to BOM TKT (Name Change and Add Infant only).
9. Remove the payment link and Change the status of the order to a name change or name correction - change.

query: how to check fare rules and cancel
answer:
Step by Step - Check fare rules and Cancel - Amadeus
Sabre
1) Open PNR in respective office id, use *PNR
2) Check Ticket status (O or A) in the ticket line. Use *T to open the ticket line. WETR*2 to open ticket
3) Check the penalties for all fare basis on the ticket. For detailed steps please refer here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/f10842cc-55dd-4ba2-842e-03abea752b0d >>.
4) If nothing is mentioned in fare rules and documents, take the most restrictive penalty within the entity (pricing unit or fare component). More information can be found here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/c5520e56-7b43-443e-87b2-7c12e5c6c98e >>.
5) Inform the passenger about the airline penalty converted in pax currency using the Order creation date along with our Refund fee. All fees are per person.
6) Inform the passenger about the airline penalty converted in his currency using the ticket issuance date along with our Refund fee. All fees are per person.
7) If he confirms: Modify the order in Edvin, selecting the correct reason (Ticket rules-airline fee)
8) No need to register an errand again. Modify order already includes that
9) Send respective confirmation email from Edvin.
10) If the ticket's rule is non-refundable, then we just inform the passenger that the ticket is non-refundable. Nothing else. Only if the passenger asks for taxes then we could check after deducting our tax refund fee if something will remain. In this case, we will inform the passenger about our fee without giving any calculation or exact refund amount. We will inform you that BO makes the calculation as some taxes may not be refunded in this case. Only if he is entitled to a refund after deducting our fee we will Modify order.

query: what to do in cases of expired tickets
answer:
Handling of expired tickets
When a customer contacts us with a refund request, the FL agent should always check the validity of the ticket at the time of contact. We have three separate cases with expired tickets:
A. Communication over phone/chat ticket expired at/before the time of contact
We should explain to the customer that the ticket is not eligible for any refund, since it is already expired.
In this case, we do not use the Modify order button as we do not want to create a refund case.
B. Communication over email ticket expired at/before the time of contact
In case A, we should explain to the customer that the ticket is not eligible for any refund, since it is already expired.
Again, we do not use the Modify order button as we do not want to create a refund case.
C. Communication over email ticket still valid at the time of contact but expired at the time of cancellation/handle
Sometimes the customer may send an email for cancellation, but due to email-related backlogs, we might not handle that email on time. Since it is not the fault if the ticket was valid at the time of contact but expired before we handle the case, we should cancel the order as normal.
Before cancelling, we should follow the step-by-step instructions to escalate the case via the Retail Loss Jira (Other) project. The Team Leader/Manager/Supervisor will then add the reason code Backlog FL and then, we should use the Modify order to create a refund case.
The BO will complete the payout and register the complaint on us.
NOTE: If any expired ticket is sent to BO for a refund (by mistake of case A & B), the BO agents will check if the ticket was expired at the time of contact. If yes, they will inform the customer via email that they are not entitled to any refund as the ticket was expired in the first place and will remove the case from the Refund Dashboard.
NOTE 2: If the ticket was still valid at the time of cancellation (which means that it expired due to BO backlogs) the payout to the customer will be completed with the complaint registered with the Backlog (BO) reason code.
Docs Ref: Refunds

query: how to void
answer:
1) Jump to correct PCC on same window: AAApcc name
2) Open PNR: *PNR
Example:
AAA4ZTH
*ABCDEF

Example: W/*56WI

Example: WV2 (where 2 is the line of the ticket)

Example: X1-4

query: how to check fare rules and cancel
answer:
Step by Step - Check fare rules and Cancel - Amadeus
Sabre
1) Open PNR in respective office id, use *PNR
2) Check Ticket status (O or A) in the ticket line. Use *T to open the ticket line. WETR*2 to open ticket
3) Check the penalties for all fare basis on the ticket. For detailed steps please refer here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/f10842cc-55dd-4ba2-842e-03abea752b0d >>.
4) If nothing is mentioned in fare rules and documents, take the most restrictive penalty within the entity (pricing unit or fare component). More information can be found here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/c5520e56-7b43-443e-87b2-7c12e5c6c98e >>.
5) Inform the passenger about the airline penalty converted in pax currency using the Order creation date along with our Refund fee. All fees are per person.
6) Inform the passenger about the airline penalty converted in his currency using the ticket issuance date along with our Refund fee. All fees are per person.
7) If he confirms: Modify the order in Edvin, selecting the correct reason (Ticket rules-airline fee)
8) No need to register an errand again. Modify order already includes that
9) Send respective confirmation email from Edvin.
10) If the ticket's rule is non-refundable, then we just inform the passenger that the ticket is non-refundable. Nothing else. Only if the passenger asks for taxes then we could check after deducting our tax refund fee if something will remain. In this case, we will inform the passenger about our fee without giving any calculation or exact refund amount. We will inform you that BO makes the calculation as some taxes may not be refunded in this case. Only if he is entitled to a refund after deducting our fee we will Modify order.
General: If a ticket was exchanged, usually you need to check the original ticket and insert the original ticket issue date in your command.
If the ticket is partially used you usually need to check the ''After departure'' section of the rules, unless otherwise specified.

answer:
Step by Step - Amadeus Manual Change
You use manual calculation only when ATC not applicable by airline and changes are permitted in fare rules in the same pnr.
Possible error message you may receive when you try ATC: Check category 31(amadeus)
Always check Fare rules (Category 16) and Max/Min. stay (Category 06 & 07) quoting rebooking charges for
manual rebooking.
The most important fare rules are:
16.PENALTIES
11.BLACKOUTS
03.SEASONS
04.FLIGHT APPL
05.ADV RES/TKTG
06.MIN STAY
07.MAX STAY
Availability
1. Retrieve pnr in respective office id, use RT+pnr
2. Make availability for new flights using below command: sn(date)(citypair)/a(al) ex: sn25decatharn/ask
3. Select seats: ss(n.of seats)(class)(line of flight) ex. SS1Y1 OR SS1YY1( If flight with connection)
4. Then RT to retrieve pnr
ATTENTION:
There are airlines, like EK where before the availability and the seat selection must be made after the original segments are removed (removed without saving). Please follow the steps below:
1. Retrieve the existing PNR
2. Remove the original dates (DO NOT SAVE any segments). Do a fresh availability and sell for the new itinerary required by the passenger. The agent may not see accurate availability, unless holding segments are cancelled.
3. After removing the segments, if there is no availability for new dates, the agent can ignore and retrieve the existing PNR No seats from the original booking would have been lost.
Pricing
1. Price all segments that he will use. If you have round trip and he asks to rebook OB and keep IB you have to include in the command new OB and old IB.
2. Pricing: Fxx/s1,2/r,up (informative- prices the class you have selected)
Or: Fxp/s1,2 ( prices the classes you have selected and saves the mask)
3. Pricing: Fxb/s1,2,4/r,up ( prices the best available combination, check that no downgrade has been done)

1. No flexible tkt: Compare fare+taxes one by one with old ticket in GDS.+penalty from fare rules and convert to pax currency
2. Create Add on cart: total yy cost+our voluntary rebooking service fee
3. If flexible applied: Compare fare+taxes one by one with old ticket in GDS.
4. If you have IT fare: Use TQT to check fare amount of original ticket.
5. Create Add on cart: Sum up fare and tax from comparison. No penalty applies
6. If passenger will not proceed or you've created Add on cart and it is not working, ignore the pnr and register errand in rebooking wizard with no queue action

query: steps for rebooking
answer:
Rebooking
How to rebook step-by -step:
1) Login to the portal, using your personal credentials.
2) Translate your page into English, using right click and selecting "Translate into English". Do not forget that in every page you move on you need to translate.
3) Once the page has been translated, click on "Consult reservations" and add the PNR and the passenger's surname as they appear in Edvin. "Search for reservations made" will always have by default selected the option "by the agency", do not try to change it.
Click on "Consult" to move on the next page.
4) After the PNR is retrieved within the portal, click on the pencil on the right, in order to be able to modify the PNR.
5) Review the details of the page and move down to the modification options. Click on "Change flight".
6) Read the fare rules and once you are ready to proceed, click on "I have read and agree to the change and cancellation policy" and "Continue".
7) Select "I want to change the flight from ...", in order to be allowed to modify the itinerary and/ or the date.
In case there is no availability to the new trip you request the below message will appear.

query: how to check fare rules and cancel
answer:
Step by Step - Check fare rules and Cancel - Amadeus
Sabre
1) Open PNR in respective office id, use *PNR
2) Check Ticket status (O or A) in the ticket line. Use *T to open the ticket line. WETR*2 to open ticket
3) Check the penalties for all fare basis on the ticket. For detailed steps please refer here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/f10842cc-55dd-4ba2-842e-03abea752b0d >>.
4) If nothing is mentioned in fare rules and documents, take the most restrictive penalty within the entity (pricing unit or fare component). More information can be found here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/c5520e56-7b43-443e-87b2-7c12e5c6c98e >>.
5) Inform the passenger about the airline penalty converted in pax currency using the Order creation date along with our Refund fee. All fees are per person.
6) Inform the passenger about the airline penalty converted in his currency using the ticket issuance date along with our Refund fee. All fees are per person.
7) If he confirms: Modify the order in Edvin, selecting the correct reason (Ticket rules-airline fee)
8) No need to register an errand again. Modify order already includes that
9) Send respective confirmation email from Edvin.
10) If the ticket's rule is non-refundable, then we just inform the passenger that the ticket is non-refundable. Nothing else. Only if the passenger asks for taxes then we could check after deducting our tax refund fee if something will remain. In this case, we will inform the passenger about our fee without giving any calculation or exact refund amount. We will inform you that BO makes the calculation as some taxes may not be refunded in this case. Only if he is entitled to a refund after deducting our fee we will Modify order.
General: If a ticket was exchanged, usually you need to check the original ticket and insert the original ticket issue date in your command.
If the ticket is partially used you usually need to check the ''After departure'' section of the rules, unless otherwise specified.

Indicates : Airport control

Indicates : Checked-in

Indicates : Exchanged

Indicates : Flown/used

Indicates : Passenger must be rerouted due to flight interruption

Indicates : Irregular operations

Indicates : Lifted/boarded

Indicates : Open for use

Indicates : Printed
Status : R
Indicates : Refunded
Status : S
Indicates : Suspended
Status : U
Indicates : Unavailable
Status : V
Indicates : Voided
Status : X
Indicates : Print Exchanged
Status : Y
Indicates : Refund tax only
Status : Z
Indicates : Closed

query: how to check fare rules and cancel
answer:
Step by Step - Check fare rules and Cancel - Amadeus
Sabre
1) Open PNR in respective office id, use *PNR
2) Check Ticket status (O or A) in the ticket line. Use *T to open the ticket line. WETR*2 to open ticket
3) Check the penalties for all fare basis on the ticket. For detailed steps please refer here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/f10842cc-55dd-4ba2-842e-03abea752b0d >>.
4) If nothing is mentioned in fare rules and documents, take the most restrictive penalty within the entity (pricing unit or fare component). More information can be found here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/c5520e56-7b43-443e-87b2-7c12e5c6c98e >>.
5) Inform the passenger about the airline penalty converted in pax currency using the Order creation date along with our Refund fee. All fees are per person.
6) Inform the passenger about the airline penalty converted in his currency using the ticket issuance date along with our Refund fee. All fees are per person.
7) If he confirms: Modify the order in Edvin, selecting the correct reason (Ticket rules-airline fee)
8) No need to register an errand again. Modify order already includes that
9) Send respective confirmation email from Edvin.
10) If the ticket's rule is non-refundable, then we just inform the passenger that the ticket is non-refundable. Nothing else. Only if the passenger asks for taxes then we could check after deducting our tax refund fee if something will remain. In this case, we will inform the passenger about our fee without giving any calculation or exact refund amount. We will inform you that BO makes the calculation as some taxes may not be refunded in this case. Only if he is entitled to a refund after deducting our fee we will Modify order.
General: If a ticket was exchanged, usually you need to check the original ticket and insert the original ticket issue date in your command.
If the ticket is partially used you usually need to check the ''After departure'' section of the rules, unless otherwise specified.

Rebooking
All the flight changes should be performed in the graphic mode. In case the original ticket had an emd (seating/baggage) the emd may not be automatically associated with the new ticket.
You need to contact the airline to reassociate the emd and if not reassociated then the customer needs to pay again. Please make sure to inform the customer in advance of this possibility.
1) In case the customer is only interested in the penalty and no specific date is provided you can see the fare rules here in Full dare conditions
1.1) The class & the status of the segment will be shown in the ticket, however, no bag info.
1.2) For Fare Breakdown of the tickets: Products -> Air segments -> Right Arrow & click on For baggage allowance of the current ticket: Click on -> we can see Fare basis & Baggage allowance
Example:
0 PC for these tickets.
2) If a date is provided then
2.1) Select the flight that you need to change:
2.2) Press on "Exchange":
2.3) Fill in the new flights:
2.4) Press on New Select the flight you want to rebook and make sure that the new flight option is with the NDC sign in the right corner. Also, it is possible to filter the new flights with Flight times, Airlines, and Cabins.
If we need to check again the Fare Rules, fare is accessible again.
At the top of the screen, you may see the total amount that the customer needs to pay to the airline.
2.5.a) If customers have bought the Flexible ticket service, they will only need to pay us the fare/tax difference (not the penalty), and after the customer's payment (in case there is a fare/tax difference), we will pay the entire amount on Amadeus NDC-X (along with the airline penalty). Therefore please check the cost separately if customers have Flexible tickets and exclude the Penalty.
The above screenshot shows the price breakdown (Price Difference = Fare/Tax Difference & the Penalties).
The customers must be charged for both of them (if they do not have flexible service).
2.5.b) Please note that for rebooking the customer needs to pay on the spot since the offer is only available for 30 minutes.
2.6) Press on the arrow for the flight details and baggage allowance.
2.6.a) Then you may inform and charge the customer accordingly.
2.6.b) For the payment link select the correct product depending on if the customer has a Flexible ticket or not.
2.6.c) In Edvin, for choosing the correct payment cart:
- When airlines require CASH as FOP, select: Airline Cost - Rebooking / New Ticket (GDS) NOT Flexible Ticket
- When airlines require VAN as FOP, select: Airline Cost - Rebooking / New Ticket (LCC) NOT Flexible Ticket
2.7) After the customer has paid
2.7.a) If AV or LO booking, issue a VAN card and click on Next.
2.7.b) If AF/KLM or AY no need for a VAN card issuance.

answer:

You use manual calculation only when ATC not applicable by airline and changes are permitted in fare rules in the same pnr.
Possible error message you may receive when you try ATC: Check category 31(amadeus)

11.BLACKOUTS

Availability

3. Select seats: ss(n.of seats)(class)(line of flight) ex. SS1Y1 OR SS1YY1( If flight with connection)
4. Then RT to retrieve pnr
ATTENTION:
There are airlines, like EK where before the availability and the seat selection must be made after the original segments are removed (removed without saving). Please follow the steps below:

query: how to check fare rules
answer:
Content - Amadeus GDS Entries
How to check fare rules
1st option: the FQP smartflow
Insert the ticket number and then the number of the flight coupons.
Select the respective option with FQQ number of options (Eg: FQQ4) If needed(if more than one option in result). Make sure all the fare bases in the selected option match the ones in your ticket.
Check the rules with FQN number of option*PE(Eg: FQN1*PE)
*Does not work for OPEN JAW tickets (ARN-ATH / ROM-ARN)
Option 2: Backdate Pricing (FXX command)
If we have active segments in the PNR, price them with the date of the ticket issuance:
FXX/S2-3,5-6/R,UP,20MAR22
FXX: is pricing command
S: are the segments numbers
20MAR22: date of ticket issuance
Select the respective option with FQQ number of options (Eg: FQQ4) If needed(if more than one option in result). Make sure all the fare bases in the selected option match the ones in your ticket.
FQQ number of option(Eg: FQQ2)
FQNnumber of option*PE(Eg: FQN2*PE)
Option 3: FQD Command
FQDCDGATH/R,UP,20MAR22/D15JUN22/AAF/CK
FQD
CDGATH: is the city pair (origin and destination of the fare component)
20MAR22: date of ticket issuance.
15JUN22: date of departure(for this city pair destination)
AAF: A is constant and AF is the 2 letter airline code (e.g Air France)
CK: C is constant and K is the booking class/first letter of the fare basis
After, use the command FQN1*PE to read the penalties where 1 is the option of the correct fare basis.
What if there is the same fare basis more than once?
Then,you will have to select the fare base where the fare amount is the same as in the original ticket.
Please compare the fare amount with the fare amount that you see beside the fare basis.

query: what to do after auto handling schedule change (sc) script
answer:
SC Script: What to do after auto handling
Customer contacted us within 5 days given period.
- Check passenger request, if passenger would like to have another alternative, then follow the below:
1. Check the status of the tickets:
1.1.Segments confirmed - ticket reissued
The majority of airlines do not authorize a second involuntary reissue, this information could be found under Edvin-> Docs.
1.1.a)Check the DOCs for airline policy
1.1.b)If no guidelines, then try to receive authority by airline for second reissue
1.1.c)If no authorization received, we need to take the cost on us, escalate the matter to your team leader / manager
1.2.Segments confirmed - ticket revalidated
Some airlines require a reissue after a SC, so even if the ticket is revalidated, we still can FOC the ticket with different flight
1.2.a)Check the DOCs for airline policy
1.2.b)If no guidelines, then try to receive authority by airline for FOC reissue
1.2.c)If no authorization received, we need to take the cost on us, escalate the matter to your team leader / manager
1.3.Segments confirmed - ticket not updated
There are some sensitive airlines which even if you confirmed the segments, but did not reissue or revalidate the ticket, the airline does not authorize FOC for another alternative flights.
1.3.a)Check the DOCs for airline policy
1.3.b)If there is a note that after segments confirmed, there is no need to revalidate the ticket and passenger will be able to travel, then try to receive authority by airline for FOC reissue.
1.3.c)If no authorization received, we need to take the cost on us, escalate the matter to your team leader / manager
1.4.d)If there is a note that after segments confirmed, we still can FOC reissue the ticket -> follow manually handling process.
2. Do NOT forget, that first valid alternative already provided by script, so we would need to charge SC fee to proceed with another alternative.
If customer would like to have an involuntary refund:
Segments confirmed - ticket reissued
The majority of airlines do not authorize a refund after invl reissue, this information could be found under Edvin-> Docs.
2.1.Check the DOCs for airline policy
2.1.a)If no guidelines, then try to receive authority from the airline
2.2.b)If no authorization received, we need to take the cost on us, escalate the matter to your team leader / manager
2.2.Segments confirmed - ticket revalidated
Some airlines require a reissue after a SC, so even if the ticket is revalidated, we still can have a full refund
2.2.a)Check the DOCs for airline policy
2.3.b)If no guidelines, then try to receive authority from the airline
2.2.c)If no authorization received, we need to take the cost on us, escalate the matter to your team leader / manager
2.3.Segments confirmed - ticket not updated
There are some sensitive airlines which even if you confirmed the segments, but did not reissue or revalidate the ticket, the airline does not authorize full refund
2.3.a)Check the DOCs for airline policy
2.3.b)If there is a note that after segments confirmed, there is no need to revalidate the ticket and passenger will be able to travel, then try to receive authority from the airline for full refund
2.3.c)If no authorization received, we need to take the cost on us, escalate the matter to your team leader / manager
2.3.d)If there is a note that after segments confirmed, we still can provide full refund proceed accordingly.

2. Check Edvin docs if we can assist him with second involuntary reissue or involuntary refund, if so proceed according to the passenger request, but do not forget to charge sc fee for reissue (as second alternative option)
If not, agent need to contact the airline for further help/information/possible authorization. Exception, as per airline policy it is clearly stated that second reissue is not allowed.

Amadeus involuntary reissued ticket
In this example there is no amount after total, instead it says NO ADC which means no additional collect. We now know that there s been no fare difference for this new ticket which indicates an involuntary reissue. It is visible in the bottom of the ticket calculation on the TOTAL amount row.

1) Availability search:
1.1) To search availability for one way trip with specific airline
AN29JUNARNAMS/AKL
or
SN29JUNARNAMS/AKL
AN -> AN (Amadeus Neutral) = displays the flights with classes of service that are open for sale or waitlist
or
SN -> SN (Schedule Neutral) = displays all flights and all classes of service regardless availability, but will allow you to book only classes open for sale
29JUN -> Date of departure
ARNAMS -> From ARN to AMS
/A -> Airline
KL -> Airline prefix; KLM
1.2) To search availability for one way trip with specific flight numbers.
AN29JUNARNHKG/AKL1110,KL887
or
SN29JUNARNHKG/AKL1110,KL887
AN -> AN (Amadeus Neutral) = displays the flights with classes of service that are open for sale or waitlist
or
SN -> SN (Schedule Neutral) = displays all flights and all classes of service regardless availability, but will allow you to book only classes open for sale
/A -> Airline
KL1104,KL887 -> Flight KL1104 on first segment, KL887 on second segment (still same bound)
1.3) To search availability for round trip with specific airline
AN29JUNARNHKG/AKL*05JULHKGARN/AKL
or
SN29JUNARNHKG/AKL*05JULHKGARN/AKL
AN29JUNARNHKG/AKL -> Date of departure, origin and destination cities, with which airline for the outbound
or
SN29JUNARNHKG/AKL -> Date of departure, origin and destination cities, with which airline for the outbound
* -> Used to separate the two entries
05JULHKGARN/AKL -> Date of departure, origin and destination cities, with which airline for the inbound
Results will display outbound and inbound availability together:
2) Booking the seats:
2.1) To book seats for one way itinerary with one segment:
SS3Q1
SS -> Seat Sell
3 -> Number of passengers
Q -> What booking class (it does not matter at this stage what booking class you choose)
1 -> What line the chosen flight is on
2.2) To book seats for one way itinerary with multiple segments:
SS5LQ1
SS -> Seat Sell
5 -> Number of persons
LQ -> What booking class on first and second segment. (it does not matter at this stage what booking class you choose)
1 -> What line the chosen flight is on
2.3) To book seats for round trip itinerary (to book outbound and inbound together):
SS4QQ2*LL1
SS -> Seat Sell
4 -> Number of persons
QQ -> What booking class on first and second segment on first bound. (it does not matter at this stage what booking class you choose)
2 -> What line the chosen flight is on for the first bound.
* -> Used to seperate the two entries
LL -> What booking class on first and second segment on second bound. (it does not matter at this stage what booking class you choose)
11 -> What line the chosen flight is on for the second bound.

query: how to rebook ticket
answer:
Sabre - Rebooking using Flex and changes not permitted:
1. *Sabre - Rebooking using Flex and changes not permitted
Availability
1. Retrieve pnr in respective office id, use *pnr
2. Clone the pnr with ICAPDXA. All details will be cloned.

4. ex: Select seats: 0 (n.seats)(class)(line n.) ex. 04k1k3

1. Price all segments that he will use. If he asks to rebook OB and keep IB you have to
2. include in the command new OB and old IB.
3. Pricing: WPS1/2 For Child: N1.1 For infant N1.1
4. Or to find best available combination: (be careful to keep the same baggage allowance as in the original ticket and to not downgrade the cabin, if a specific one has been selected).
Calculation
1. flexible applied: Compare total new cost with Edvin Air cost.
2. If partialy used ticket: Compare total new cost with half of Edvin Air cost.
3. Create payment link: Include the fare/tax difference in his currency. No penalty applies
4. If passenger will not proceed or you send PL for 30 min, ignore the pnr and register errand in Edvin with Rebooking template ( Flex tkt new tkt)
Proceed with change
1. Once payment link is paid we do all above steps again
2. Save new seats with initials and then ER and then IR to get locator
3. Use 7T-A for ticketing element if needed. then initials and ER
4. Delete old segments( UC segment): x1-2 and save with initials+er and ir to double check

1. Then open original pnr again:

query: how to add seating
answer:
1) Jump to the correct office ID on the same window: AAAPCC name.
2) Open PNR: *PNR.
3) Make sure the segments' status is HK.
4) Open the seat map with 4Gx* command, where x is the segment number on which we will select the seat.
Example: 4G1*:
5) Hover over a specific seat to check its price and inform the customer.
6) If the customer is not interested just close this window.
7) If the customer would like to proceed with the payment, click on a specific seat to add it to the passenger:
We will see the total price for the specific flight.
8) Click on SAVE button.
9) Close the window.
10) Display the Seats list with *B to check their status. It has to be HK or KK:
NW - window seat
NA - aisle seat
Action should be saved in the end with 6your initials, ER
IR to refresh the PNR.
11) At the same time, if the seat is chargeable, an Air Extra will appear:
To open the seat map open PNR Services in graphical mode and choose Air Extras
To remove Seating
1) Retrieve the list with reserved seats using the command *B.
2) The command 4GX1,2 will cancel the seats and the ancillary request for lines 1 and 2 at the same time.
Action should be saved in the end with 6your initials, ER.
Docs Ref: Sabre GDS Entries

query: what are the steps to void
answer:
Content - Amadeus GDS Entries
How to Void
Jump to correct office ID, just click on the office ID.
To open pnr: RTPNR
Open ticket list for all passengers: RTTN
Check if Void is permitted as per the documents in Edvin, based on the time of ticket issuance, which is indicated in the time zone of the respective office ID.
To check what is currently the time in the respective office ID, do the below command:
DDYYZ if our ticketing office is YYZ, aka Toronto.
If void is possible:
Void each ticket and each emd with command: TRDC/L1(the ticket line) or TRDC/TK-eticket number (without the 3 first)
Example: TRDC/L45
Where 45 is the line of the ticket
To cancel segments, use the command XE segment lines
Example: XE1-4
Every action should be saved in the end with ER

answer:

You use manual calculation only when ATC not applicable by airline and changes are permitted in fare rules in the same pnr.
Possible error message you may receive when you try ATC: Check category 31(amadeus)
Always check Fare rules (Category 16) and Max/Min. stay (Category 06 & 07) quoting rebooking charges for
manual rebooking.

16.PENALTIES
11.BLACKOUTS
03.SEASONS

1. Retrieve pnr in respective office id, use RT+pnr
2. Make availability for new flights using below command: sn(date)(citypair)/a(al) ex: sn25decatharn/ask
3. Select seats: ss(n.of seats)(class)(line of flight) ex. SS1Y1 OR SS1YY1( If flight with connection)
4. Then RT to retrieve pnr
ATTENTION:
There are airlines, like EK where before the availability and the seat selection must be made after the original segments are removed (removed without saving). Please follow the steps below:
1. Retrieve the existing PNR
2. Remove the original dates (DO NOT SAVE any segments). Do a fresh availability and sell for the new itinerary required by the passenger. The agent may not see accurate availability, unless holding segments are cancelled.
3. After removing the segments, if there is no availability for new dates, the agent can ignore and retrieve the existing PNR No seats from the original booking would have been lost.

1. Price all segments that he will use. If you have round trip and he asks to rebook OB and keep IB you have to include in the command new OB and old IB.
2. Pricing: Fxx/s1,2/r,up (informative- prices the class you have selected)
Or: Fxp/s1,2 ( prices the classes you have selected and saves the mask)

1. No flexible tkt: Compare fare+taxes one by one with old ticket in GDS.+penalty from fare rules and convert to pax currency

3. If flexible applied: Compare fare+taxes one by one with old ticket in GDS.
4. If you have IT fare: Use TQT to check fare amount of original ticket.
5. Create Add on cart: Sum up fare and tax from comparison. No penalty applies

answer:
Step by Step - Check fare rules and Cancel - Amadeus
Sabre
1) Open PNR in respective office id, use *PNR
2) Check Ticket status (O or A) in the ticket line. Use *T to open the ticket line. WETR*2 to open ticket

5) Inform the passenger about the airline penalty converted in pax currency using the Order creation date along with our Refund fee. All fees are per person.

7) If he confirms: Modify the order in Edvin, selecting the correct reason (Ticket rules-airline fee)
8) No need to register an errand again. Modify order already includes that

answer:
Involuntary refund in Amadeus NDC X
DO NOT ADD A GHOSTLINE TO THE AMADEUS NDCx PNR
Procedure for Handling Refunds
1) Document Verification in Edvin: The FL/SC agent is responsible for reviewing Edvin's documents to ensure that an involuntary refund is authorized in accordance with policy guidelines.
2) Deadline Check
2.1) Verify if there are any specific deadlines associated with processing this refund
2.2) If yes, and it is close to the deadline as per airline policy, or SSR, or guide (within 4 hours of the deadline), then the agent should prioritize the refund and manually handle the refund.
2.3) If no deadlines are indicated, proceed with the following steps:
3) Handling Based on Original Travel Time:

Checklist:

3) Have I remembered to void all the tickets including infants and EMDs?

6) Is it a CC2C order?
7) Remember to void before you cancel the segments. It is much more time-consuming to do it afterwards...
8) Voiding a ticket is only possible if the ticket was issued the same day (voiding is possible until midnight and if no discrepancies apply according to airline info in Edvin and/or fare rules)
ATTENTION: In case you are processing void and the tickets are not issued yet, please make sure that before and after modifying the order you will do IR to make sure that there are no tickets issued in the meantime.
Unless the order in Edvin is marked with the banner 'Delayed Ticketing', the tickets in the GDS are issued automatically, usually within 10 minutes from the time of the order creation/ payment.
Follow below guidelines for void in Amadeus/ Sabre.
1) Check if the void is still possible technically (time conversion)
To be sure of the issuing date and place of issue, open the tickets in GDS. Due to the fact that we have many different office IDs, we need to check the time in the issuing area.
For example, this ticket was booked on 10 January 20 in the SYD office.
Customer called us a few hours later and asked for cancellation (VOID).
Ticket is issued in our area: SYD
We need to check what time and day it is now that we wish to void the ticket in SYD so as to make sure we are still in the same calendar day for the area the ticket was issued in.
Use command in amadeus DDXXX (where XXX is the POI area of our ticket).
E.g DDSYD
2) Check if the airline has any restrictions in Edvin docs and/or GDS with the following commands
After you have made sure that for the ticket issuance area we are still on the same calendar day, we need to check if there are any restrictions by the airline for permitting void.
Void is not guaranteed for all airlines, tickets and/or fare types.
First check Edvin CXL docs for the airline that the ticket stock belongs to so as to make sure if there are any restrictions in place for your ticket.
If there is nothing mentioned in Edvin docs, do not assume that the void option is eligible.
You need to follow the next 2 steps to make sure we can void the ticket without receiving later on either an error or a charge by the airline.
2.1) Open fare rules and read the section for any void restriction.
2.2) Do the HEETT + YY code command in Amadeus to check if VOID is permitted by the airline in the respective office, even if the ticket is issued in Sabre.
E.g let's say we need to check void for KM airline in AU (SYD) office.
We do HEETT + YY code and search for the country code corresponding to the ticket issuance office.
If you handle a Sabre booking and you are not sure which country code corresponds to the ticket issuance office, you may use in Sabre the command W/* + PCC office code.
Once you find the relevant market, type the respective command visible on the right side in order to check the restrictions for the office you need:
Our next command is MS22 and we move down until we find stands for void is technically possible.
3) If void is possible and passenger wishes to proceed after informing them our handling fee, continue with the void commands.
Note:
You must be in the correct area where the ticket has been issued, to be able to void it, or else system will respond with error message
ETKT DOCUMENTS NOT FOUND or VOID ENTRY MUST BE MADE BY PSEUDO CITY OF ORIGINAL.
EMD's must be voided as well if voiding the air tickets.
If partial cancellation is applied, always split the passengers who want to cancel, guidelines can be found here.
If you have cancelled the segments before void entry:
You can void after, if you use: TRDC/TK-TKTNR.
Always remove the first 3 numbers in the ticket number.
EX: TRDC/TK-144XXXXXX
Don't forget to void all the tickets if all tickets are affected.
Please see cancellation fee in Edvin.
How to Void Ticket and EMD
Open the PNR in the GDS and check whether the tickets and EMD are issued.
Amadeus RTTN
Sabre *T
In Amadeus, the ticket line number will be denoted by 'ET', circled in purple above and the EMD will be denoted by 'DT', circled in red. In this example, LH is the issuing carrier/plating carrier for the ticket and EMD.
4) Delete the segments
5) Add ghostline
6) Run Modify Order with reason Send Void confirmation email from Edvin
Amadeus:
Retrieve pnr in respective office id, use RT+PNR
Check Ticket status (O or A) in ticket line. Use RTTN to open ticket line. TWD/L(1) to open ticket.
Check issuance date and time in the respective office id city.
Check documents for void exceptions. If nothing is mentioned in Edvin docs, check the fare rules and do the WETP*YY command as described above. If no restrictions are found, move on to the next step.
Void tickets: TRDC/L1(no. of ticket line) or TRDC/TK+10digit of tkt number without 3 first. Ex: TRDC/TK12548598756

Press RTTN to open tickets records

Check the status of the ticket: if it is V, means the ticket was successfully voided
Delete segments: XE1-5 or XE1,3 and then ER to save and IR to double check
Proceed with the Modify Order key in Edvin and select: Void
(Note: "Modify Order" creates automatically a register errand! Write free flow text as order note in "note" box and insert all fees in details.
Send cancellation confirmation email from Edvin for Void
***ATTENTION***
For Domestic tickets issued in Amadeus office ID SELK138TF when voiding a ticket, you should add at the end of the voiding command /T-YY . YY stands for the validating carrier (the carrier who issued the ticket).
Therefore, the commands that should be used are:
- TRDC/Lticket line/T-and the validating carrier code.
Example: TRDC/L35/T-KE - Void the ticket in line 35 that was issued by KE Korean Air.
or
- TRDC/TKthe 10 digits of the ticket/T-and the validating carrier code.
Example: TRDC/TK1234567890/T-KE - Void the ticket number 1234567890 that was issued by KE Korean Air.
For ALL tickets issued in Amadeus office ID SAO2R21Z6 and for JJ as operating carrier and LA as marketing carrier, the void should be made as per below:
- TRDC/Lticket line/T-and the validating carrier code.
Example: TRDC/L35/T-JJ - Void the ticket in line 35 that was issued by JJ LATAM Brazil.
or
- TRDC/TKthe 10 digits of the ticket/T-and the validating carrier code.
Example: TRDC/TK1234567890/T-JJ - Void the ticket number 1234567890 that was issued by JJ LATAM Brazil.

query: how to refund involuntary reissued ticket
answer:
Amadeus involuntary reissued ticket
In this example there is no amount after total, instead it says NO ADC which means no additional collect. We now know that there s been no fare difference for this new ticket which indicates an involuntary reissue. It is visible in the bottom of the ticket calculation on the TOTAL amount row.
But to be absolutely sure we need to check the remarks and look for an EMD in the PNR. To check, use either RTF or RHFA to locate any possible additional EMD and ticket numbers.
For involuntary reissued tickets with no ADC the form of payment (FP line, abbreviated to FOP) is always the same as the original ticket.
Refund of involuntary reissued ticket
When a ticket is reissued due to involuntary reasons we always try to find seats available in the same class, but if that is not possible the airline might give an authorization to upgrade the ticket.
This could mean that the refund rules differ between the original ticket and the reissued one. However since it is not by the choice of the passenger to change the ticket we will always go by the rules of the original ticket in this scenario.
Check the rules of the original ticket.
Try to access the original ticket from the history in the PNR using RHFA and TWD/TKT055-XXXXXXXX70. If you cannot access the ticket, check the original farebasis with TTH command. More info on how to display the history of active/purged PNR can be found here. << https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/aa559017-1c97-4d87-b867-ed17eb30a5dd?parentId=6dc689bb-e384-4c3b-9479-3ea92eeee5e3&view=snippet-view&trigger=title&searchEventId=01GCRJ7RYMTWEGYCBRGAASZA8R&source=shelf >>

query: steps for involuntary refund
answer:
Involuntary refund in Amadeus NDC X
DO NOT ADD A GHOSTLINE TO THE AMADEUS NDCx PNR
Procedure for Handling Refunds
1) Document Verification in Edvin: The FL/SC agent is responsible for reviewing Edvin's documents to ensure that an involuntary refund is authorized in accordance with policy guidelines.
2) Deadline Check
2.1) Verify if there are any specific deadlines associated with processing this refund
2.2) If yes, and it is close to the deadline as per airline policy, or SSR, or guide (within 4 hours of the deadline), then the agent should prioritize the refund and manually handle the refund.
2.3) If no deadlines are indicated, proceed with the following steps:
3) Handling Based on Original Travel Time:
3.1) If Original Travel is More than 4 Hours:
3.1.1) Update the Modify button accordingly, allowing SL to assume the case.
3.1.2) Ensure any applicable waiver codes are documented clearly in the errands.
3.1.3) Remove the segments if possible
3.1.4) Send cancellation confirmation email from Edvin
3.2) If Original Travel is Within or Less than 4 Hours:
Follow the manual handling refund routine and handle it.
Manual refund handling
1) Retrieve the Booking file in Amadeus NDCx
2) Check if it is possible to proceed with the refund and the waiver is provided
3) If the waiver is provided for this airline:
3.1) In the Products section, select the flight you want to cancel. All segments of the flight are automatically selected.
4) In the Products section of the booking file, display the Cancel Order drop-down list and select Cancel Order.
The Cancel NDC order window box is displayed, showing that any penalty or fee has been waived.
Depending on the airline and the situation, the order is Canceled, Refunded or Voided.
5) Click Cancel order to continue.
If the airline considers the cancellation as a refund, the refundable amount is displayed.
6) Click Cancel Order now to finalize the cancellation
Message confirms the cancellation, void or refund has been done successfully
7) Click Continue to display the Booking file
If the waiver is NOT provided for this airline:
1) Contact the airline directly for assistance by phone
2)Ask to proceed with full refund or apply a BSP
If BSP is required, then FL/SC agent needs to use Modify order to apply BSP, add note '' BSP NEEDED'' in ''Other info to BO'' box. FL/SC agent need to escalate the PNR to SL for BSP refund by using the label:
NDC - RA in BSP add info in the order note field:
1) Ticket and/or EMD number to be claimed
2) Penalty quoted to pax, if applicable.
3) Waiver, if applicable.
4) Document to attach, if applicable.
5) Reason for escalating (eg. Invl refund after exchange)
5.1) Send cancellation confirmation email from Edvin
5.2) Remove the case from SC Queue manually with a command from the command page.
Example of the command:
Description: QR/Office ID/Queue and Category
QR/AMSAA2222/77C60
This should remove the PNR from the Queue.

query: steps for void cancellation
answer:
Step by Step - Void a Ticket - Amadeus
Checklist:
1) Have I checked in Edvin for any void restrictions? If nothing is mentioned in the docs, have I checked the fare rules and the HEETT(YY) command?
2) Have I checked if the VOID automation applies as described here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/09665f68-4407-41b5-a687-4078dc2f7e7a >>?
3) Have I remembered to void all the tickets including infants and EMDs?
4) Is it a Single or Multiple PNR?
5) Any LCC involved?
6) Is it a CC2C order?
7) Remember to void before you cancel the segments. It is much more time-consuming to do it afterwards...
8) Voiding a ticket is only possible if the ticket was issued the same day (voiding is possible until midnight and if no discrepancies apply according to airline info in Edvin and/or fare rules)
ATTENTION: In case you are processing void and the tickets are not issued yet, please make sure that before and after modifying the order you will do IR to make sure that there are no tickets issued in the meantime.
Unless the order in Edvin is marked with the banner 'Delayed Ticketing', the tickets in the GDS are issued automatically, usually within 10 minutes from the time of the order creation/ payment.
Follow below guidelines for void in Amadeus/ Sabre.
1) Check if the void is still possible technically (time conversion)
To be sure of the issuing date and place of issue, open the tickets in GDS. Due to the fact that we have many different office IDs, we need to check the time in the issuing area.
For example, this ticket was booked on 10 January 20 in the SYD office.
Customer called us a few hours later and asked for cancellation (VOID).
Ticket is issued in our area: SYD
We need to check what time and day it is now that we wish to void the ticket in SYD so as to make sure we are still in the same calendar day for the area the ticket was issued in.
Use command in amadeus DDXXX (where XXX is the POI area of our ticket).
E.g DDSYD
2) Check if the airline has any restrictions in Edvin docs and/or GDS with the following commands
After you have made sure that for the ticket issuance area we are still on the same calendar day, we need to check if there are any restrictions by the airline for permitting void.
Void is not guaranteed for all airlines, tickets and/or fare types.
First check Edvin CXL docs for the airline that the ticket stock belongs to so as to make sure if there are any restrictions in place for your ticket.
If there is nothing mentioned in Edvin docs, do not assume that the void option is eligible.
You need to follow the next 2 steps to make sure we can void the ticket without receiving later on either an error or a charge by the airline.
2.1) Open fare rules and read the section for any void restriction.
2.2) Do the HEETT + YY code command in Amadeus to check if VOID is permitted by the airline in the respective office, even if the ticket is issued in Sabre.

query: nach policy br market
answer:
On a go forward, when we receive a name correction or name change request from anyone who has booked through the following 4 sites, we MUST initiate the name correction/change with the airline.
A change to a different passenger is not permitted except if the airline's policy allows it.
Gotogate BR
Mytrip BR
Flightnetwork BR
Booking.com BR

Important points to keep in or not the airline is able to do the name correction or name change, we must inquire with the airline in writing so we have it on record that we initiated the request
Our naco/nach fee will always apply, regardless if the airline cost is FOC
You should charge our service fees only if the name correction/change has been approved by the airline, along with airline cost for the correction. No fees shall be prepaid before we are sure that the name correction/change is possible.
Majority of the name correction/change will be for Gol Linhas G3, Latam LA, Azul Airlines AD & LATAM Airlines Brasil JJ.
For LCC bookings, where in Edvin documents it is stated that we should NEVER contact the airline, please refer the customers to the airline directly.
For all other booking sources including Consolid, we must assist with the naco/nach, follow the normal routines

query: steps for rebooking with manual change
answer:
Step by Step - Amadeus Manual Change
You use manual calculation only when ATC not applicable by airline and changes are permitted in fare rules in the same pnr.
Possible error message you may receive when you try ATC: Check category 31(amadeus)
Always check Fare rules (Category 16) and Max/Min. stay (Category 06 & 07) quoting rebooking charges for
manual rebooking.
The most important fare rules are:
16.PENALTIES
11.BLACKOUTS
03.SEASONS
04.FLIGHT APPL
05.ADV RES/TKTG
06.MIN STAY
07.MAX STAY
Availability
1. Retrieve pnr in respective office id, use RT+pnr
2. Make availability for new flights using below command: sn(date)(citypair)/a(al) ex: sn25decatharn/ask
3. Select seats: ss(n.of seats)(class)(line of flight) ex. SS1Y1 OR SS1YY1( If flight with connection)
4. Then RT to retrieve pnr
ATTENTION:
There are airlines, like EK where before the availability and the seat selection must be made after the original segments are removed (removed without saving). Please follow the steps below:
1. Retrieve the existing PNR
2. Remove the original dates (DO NOT SAVE any segments). Do a fresh availability and sell for the new itinerary required by the passenger. The agent may not see accurate availability, unless holding segments are cancelled.
3. After removing the segments, if there is no availability for new dates, the agent can ignore and retrieve the existing PNR No seats from the original booking would have been lost.
Pricing
1. Price all segments that he will use. If you have round trip and he asks to rebook OB and keep IB you have to include in the command new OB and old IB.
2. Pricing: Fxx/s1,2/r,up (informative- prices the class you have selected)
Or: Fxp/s1,2 ( prices the classes you have selected and saves the mask)
3. Pricing: Fxb/s1,2,4/r,up ( prices the best available combination, check that no downgrade has been done)
4. To open specific fare basis pricing mask use FQQ(line of fare basis you want)
Calculation
1. No flexible tkt: Compare fare+taxes one by one with old ticket in GDS.+penalty from fare rules and convert to pax currency
2. Create Add on cart: total yy cost+our voluntary rebooking service fee
3. If flexible applied: Compare fare+taxes one by one with old ticket in GDS.
4. If you have IT fare: Use TQT to check fare amount of original ticket.
5. Create Add on cart: Sum up fare and tax from comparison. No penalty applies
6. If passenger will not proceed or you've created Add on cart and it is not working, ignore the pnr and register errand in rebooking wizard with no queue action
Proceed with change

query: step by step check fare rules and cancel
answer:
Step by Step - Check fare rules and Cancel - Amadeus
Amadeus
1) Open PNR in respective office id, use RT+PNR
2) Check Ticket status (O or A) in the ticket line. Use RTTN or RTF to open the ticket line. TWD/L1 to open ticket on line 1.
3) Check the penalties for all fare basis on the ticket. For detailed steps please refer here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/099b9fac-cdb3-4d9f-b904-e20b80ca9e56 >>.
4) If nothing is mentioned in fare rules and documents, take the most restrictive penalty within the entity (pricing unit or fare component). More information can be found here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/c5520e56-7b43-443e-87b2-7c12e5c6c98e >>.
5) Inform the passenger about the airline penalty converted in pax currency using the Order creation date along with our Refund fee. All fees are per person.
6) If the passenger confirms cancellation, delete segments.
7) If he confirms: Modify the order in Edvin, selecting the correct reason (Ticket rules-airline fee)
8) No need to register an errand again. Modify order already includes that.
9) Send respective confirmation email from Edvin.
10) If the ticket's rule is non-refundable, then we just inform the passenger that the ticket is non-refundable. Nothing else. Only if a passenger asks for taxes then we could check after deducting our tax refund fee if something will remain. In this case, we will inform the passenger about our fee without giving any calculation or exact refund amount. We will inform you that BO makes the calculation as some taxes may not be refunded in this case. Only if the customer is entitled to a refund after deducting our fee we will Modify order.
General: If a ticket was exchanged, usually you need to check the original ticket and insert the original ticket issue date in your command.
If the ticket is partially used you usually need to check the ''After departure'' section of the rules, unless otherwise specified.

Indicates : Checked-in

Indicates : Exchanged

Indicates : Flown/used

Indicates : Passenger must be rerouted due to flight interruption

Indicates : Irregular operations

Indicates : Lifted/boarded
Status : O
Indicates : Open for use
Status : P
Indicates : Printed
Status : R
Indicates : Refunded
Status : S
Indicates : Suspended
Status : U
Indicates : Unavailable
Status : V
Indicates : Voided
Status : X
Indicates : Print Exchanged
Status : Y
Indicates : Refund tax only
Status : Z
Indicates : Closed

query: how to refund involuntary reissued ticket
answer:
Amadeus involuntary reissued ticket
In this example there is no amount after total, instead it says NO ADC which means no additional collect. We now know that there s been no fare difference for this new ticket which indicates an involuntary reissue. It is visible in the bottom of the ticket calculation on the TOTAL amount row.
But to be absolutely sure we need to check the remarks and look for an EMD in the PNR. To check, use either RTF or RHFA to locate any possible additional EMD and ticket numbers.

1) Check if the void is still possible technically (time conversion)
To be sure of the issuing date and place of issue, open the tickets in GDS. Due to the fact that we have many different office IDs, we need to check the time in the issuing area.
For example, this ticket was booked on 10 January 20 in the SYD office.
Customer called us a few hours later and asked for cancellation (VOID).
Ticket is issued in our area: SYD
We need to check what time and day it is now that we wish to void the ticket in SYD so as to make sure we are still in the same calendar day for the area the ticket was issued in.
Use command in amadeus DDXXX (where XXX is the POI area of our ticket).
E.g DDSYD
2) Check if the airline has any restrictions in Edvin docs and/or GDS with the following commands
After you have made sure that for the ticket issuance area we are still on the same calendar day, we need to check if there are any restrictions by the airline for permitting void.

If there is nothing mentioned in Edvin docs, do not assume that the void option is eligible.

Once you find the relevant market, type the respective command visible on the right side in order to check the restrictions for the office you need:
Our next command is MS22 and we move down until we find stands for void is technically possible.

ETKT DOCUMENTS NOT FOUND or VOID ENTRY MUST BE MADE BY PSEUDO CITY OF ORIGINAL.
EMD's must be voided as well if voiding the air tickets.
